notes:
Snapshot notes / call fragments, shorthand and quotes: 
- Vertical: mid-market SaaS (product analytics + help center) — high volume chat, multi-tenant UI
- Primary workload: in-app conversational agent for support routing + proactive suggestions; also nightly summary emails (batch summarization).
- Latency SLO: target p95 end-to-end streaming response <250ms for accepted flows, absolute hard cap 300ms. VP Eng: "We can't tolerate >300ms p95 in UI; will drop agent if laggy."
- Tooling: heavy tool-calling (search index, internal knowledgebase, ticket create/update, 3rd-party CRM webhooks). Need reliable function-calling semantics and deterministic fallbacks.
- Quality guardrails: want prompt/eval regression gating around agent responses tied to A/B and canary rollouts. Must be able to run evals on PR/prompts and block rollouts when delta quality < -5% on weighted metrics.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget but expects clear unit economics. Wants Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization to hit cost targets without harming p95.
- Deployment path: start hosted API for fast iteration + eval harness; commit to Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) when steady-state throughput & latency proven. Also evaluating VPC option for data isolation.
- Security ask: SSO (SAML), audit logs surfaced to their SIEM, KMS integration for keys, retention controls for transcripts, and EU residency for EU customers.
- Success criteria for POC: 1) streaming p95 <250ms on representative traffic, 2) function-calls reliability >99% for N=1000 calls, 3) eval suite A/B showing no regression on top-3 fidelity prompts, 4) cost/P95 tradeoff report and recommended dedicated sizing.
- Quote from Head of Product: "If Redwood can run streaming + tool-calls at our latency and give us an automated rollback when prompts regress, we'll move to Dedicated."
- Internal champion: Senior PM (Liam Ortiz) — owns acceptance criteria and test corpus.
- Pricing: asked for starter Dedicated estimate + hosted overage model; finance needs a 12-month committed quote.
- Next immediate items: SE to provide POC runbook, Redwood to share eval harness and sampling code, security to answer questionnaire (SEC-4122).
- Risks: dataset residency for EU customers still open; pricing variance for peak months; unknown tail-latency on third-party tool calls.
